name: ci-memory-agents-runner
description: Runs the CI memory experiment automatically through GitHub Copilot

commands.title: CI Memory: Run A Single Task
CI Memory: List Available Copilot Models

ciMemory.agent.description: Name of the runs/<agent> folder to fill in

ciMemory.delaySeconds.description: Pause between runs, to stay within Copilot rate limits

ciMemory.maxRuns.description: Stop after this many runs. 0 means no limit.
